picks.t: Oh, Mary! - Final Weekend at ACT Curran Theatre
picks.w: Fri Oct 30 - Sun Nov 1 · Various Times
picks.d: This is it ,  the Tony Award-winning dark comedy closes forever on November 1st and Sammy personally insists you go. If you've been sleeping on this one, wake up right now and buy a ticket. Final curtain falls Sunday night and you will absolutely regret missing it.

Four blocks, three stages, a costume contest, trick-or-treating, a glowing neon dance party, and the most legendary Halloween crowd in San Francisco ,  all for free. The Castro on Halloween is a bucket-list experience, full stop. Wear something spectacular.

picks.t: Galactic - Two-Night Halloween Run at The Fillmore
picks.d: New Orleans funk legends Galactic are doing two nights at The Fillmore for Halloween weekend, and honestly there is no better band to ring in the spooky season with. Friday has young guitar phenom Bella Rayne opening, Saturday features instrumental organ trio Parlor Greens. Either night is a guaranteed dance party.

picks.t: Nightmare on Front Street - Free Halloween Block Party
picks.d: Three beloved downtown bars ,  Schroeder's, Harrington's, and Royal Exchange ,  take over Front Street for a totally free Halloween block party with live DJs, themed cocktails, spooky activities, and a sea of costumes. Great pre-game for a bigger night out, or perfect as the main event.

picks.t: Galactic: Madre Cumbia - Los Gaiteros de San Jacinto, Fruko & Carmelo Torres
picks.d: This one is genuinely rare ,  a landmark gathering of Colombian cumbia masters at GAMH, bringing together the traditional Gaita flute sounds of Los Gaiteros de San Jacinto with salsa-funk royalty Fruko and guitar legend Carmelo Torres. World music fans, this is your moment. Monday nights don't usually look like this.

picks.t: AURA: An Immersive Odyssey at Grace Cathedral
picks.d: Montreal studio Moment Factory has turned Grace Cathedral into a living stage of light, projection, and original music ,  and it is absolutely stunning in person. The 52-minute experience includes an interactive web app exploration and a 37-minute full immersive show inside one of SF's most iconic spaces. Tickets from around $24 and worth every penny.

picks.t: Marshmello - Lost in Dreams Halloween Block Party
picks.d: Marshmello headlines a massive outdoor block party at The Midway with ARMNHMR, Grabbitz, CHYL, GhostDragon, and more on the bill ,  then an afterparty runs until 2am. If big EDM and a high-energy Halloween crowd is your scene, The Midway is the place to be Friday night. GA tickets start around $32.

picks.t: Team Dresch + Longstocking + The Third Sex at Bottom of the Hill
picks.d: Queercore legends Team Dresch playing Bottom of the Hill alongside fellow icons Longstocking and The Third Sex ,  all-ages, $20-$25, and exactly the kind of sweaty, joyful, politically-charged punk show that Bottom of the Hill was built for. This is a genuinely special reunion night.

picks.t: Squirrel Flower + Sour Widows at The Chapel
picks.d: Squirrel Flower's Ella Williams makes luminous folk-indie that deserves to be heard in a room as warm and beautiful as The Chapel ,  and local favorites Sour Widows are basically the perfect opener. If you want a Thursday night that feels like a hug, this is it. Tickets around $27.

picks.t: Scaregrove at Stern Grove - Free Family Halloween
picks.d: Stern Grove goes full Halloween with a haunted house, carnival rides, a hay maze, arts and crafts, live entertainment, and food ,  all completely free in one of SF's most beautiful outdoor settings. Perfect if you've got kids in tow or just want to ease into the Halloween weekend with something wholesome and fun before it gets weird later.

The Venezuelan-American freak-folk icon brings his otherworldly baritone, playful mysticism, and beautifully ornate songwriting to The Fillmore ,  one of those perfect venue-artist matches that SF is so good at producing. If you've never seen Devendra live, this is your week to fix that.

picks.t: RM x SFMOMA: Between You and Me
picks.d: BTS's RM has co-curated an exhibition with SFMOMA bringing together 200 works from both of their collections ,  it's genuinely fascinating and drawing a wonderfully unexpected crowd of art lovers and stans alike. First-floor installations are free to see, and the full show opened this October.

picks.t: Asian Art Museum - Free First Sunday (Nov 1)
picks.d: November 1st is Free First Sunday at the Asian Art Museum, where you can catch Ha Chong-Hyun's sweeping retrospective of six decades of innovative abstraction AND a once-in-a-lifetime visit from Southeast Asia's largest ancient bronze of Vishnu. Completely free, genuinely world-class. Go before brunch.

picks.t: Halcyon's 10th Anniversary: Sam Divine - Welcome to the Raveyard
picks.d: House music icon Sam Divine headlines Halcyon's 10th birthday party with a Halloween theme called Welcome to the Raveyard ,  and Halcyon's 24-hour licensed warehouse space with its pristine Pioneer Pro Audio system is the kind of room that makes you fall in love with clubbing all over again. A decade of this venue is worth celebrating.

ongoing.t: Dear San Francisco at Club Fugazi
ongoing.d: The 7 Fingers' acrobatic love letter to the city runs nightly ,  tickets from $79 and worth it.

ongoing.t: Peter Pan Goes Wrong - SF Playhouse
ongoing.d: High-energy comedic theater runs through November 28 at the Union Square stage.

ongoing.t: SFMOMA: Graciela Iturbide - Between Two Worlds
ongoing.d: Stunning black-and-white photography survey through November 29.

ongoing.t: de Young: Treasures of the Pharaohs
ongoing.d: Major Egyptian antiquities exhibition runs through January 31 ,  free for Bay Area residents first Tuesday of the month.

ongoing.t: Minnesota Street Project - David Driskell: Wake Up Everybody
ongoing.d: Free admission, Jenkins Johnson Gallery, through December 19 in Dogpatch.

new.name: Lucania
new.d: All-day ferry building gem from the A16 team ,  sardines, pizza, pasta, and a killer outdoor patio overlooking the Embarcadero.

new.name: Shinka
new.d: Omakase-style tasting inside The Jay Hotel with chawanmushi, miso cod, and shio koji duck wellington.

new.name: Bayview Oyster Bar
new.d: Grilled and raw oysters, Dungeness crab with garlic noodles, and clam chowder from the chef behind the beloved Auntie April's.

new.name: Chicano Nuevo
new.d: A $95 tasting menu with absolutely no skips ,  critics say it's one of the best value tasting menus in the city right now.

new.name: 15 Romolo
new.d: The 115-year-old pseudo-speakeasy just finished a two-year renovation ,  back with Pimm's cups, sherry, and a refreshed interior down its hidden alley.

new.name: Woods Grotto
new.d: Woods Beer & Wine Co.'s sixth SF location brings their reliable lineup plus harbor views and empanadas to Fisherman's Wharf.

classic.name: Noor
classic.d: Order the Muglai Chicken Changezi ,  a spicy cashew curry loaded with smoky chicken that critics say is the only thing you need on the menu.

classic.name: Ah Ma's Kitchen
classic.d: One of only two Bay Area spots on Yelp's national Best New Restaurants of 2026 list ,  Cantonese flavors and a taste of Hong Kong on Clement Street.

classic.name: Kaiyō Handroll Bar
classic.d: The beloved Cow Hollow spot reinvented as a handroll bar ,  tableside carts, ceviche, lomo saltado, and excellent cocktails still intact.

classic.name: Sangria & Salt
classic.d: Rated the worthy spiritual successor to Cha Cha Cha with a fun atmosphere, great sangria, and open until midnight.

classic.name: Linea Caffe (18th St)
classic.d: Their third SF location right by Dolores Park ,  espresso drinks, frozen coffee slushies, and pastries from Neighbor Bakehouse and Dynamo Donuts.

classic.name: La Cigale
classic.d: No tips, no reservations ,  just excellent wood-fired cooking in a refreshingly unpretentious Glen Park neighborhood spot.

bars.name: 15 Romolo
bars.d: Freshly renovated after two years away ,  the alley speakeasy is back with great cocktails and that same irreplaceable bohemian energy.

bars.name: Halcyon SF
bars.d: Celebrating its 10th anniversary this week with Sam Divine on the decks ,  pristine sound system, wrap-around projections, and a 24-hour license for special events.

bars.name: The Midway
bars.d: The epicenter of SF's Halloween EDM weekend with Marshmello Friday and RL Grime Saturday ,  massive outdoor block parties both nights.

bars.name: Underground SF
bars.d: Intimate 100-capacity room on Haight Street hosting Halloween Underground with Primo and Oso Feo ,  the real underground Halloween experience.

bars.name: Public Works SF
bars.d: Lost Miracle (Sébastien Léger & Roy Rosenfeld) plus Satori on Halloween eve ,  one of SF's most beloved mid-size venues doing what it does best.

bars.name: Audio SF
bars.d: Darude on Friday and Sistek on Saturday make Audio the underground Halloween alternative to the mega-shows ,  serious club sound, serious crowd.

bars.name: Delah Coffee / Haraz / Heyma
bars.d: Late-night Yemeni coffee and pastries ,  all three open past 10pm, some until 1am on weekends, and genuinely one of SF's best late-night habits.

bars.name: Hi NRG
bars.d: New Richmond location with expanded food, pastries, sandwiches, ice cream sundaes ,  and wine at night when the coffee crowd clears out.

Potential WNBA Finals Game 7 ,  winner-take-all on Halloween night, tickets on sale now
Sunday home game ,  great afternoon option before evening shows
Close out the week with another home game at Chase Center

sports.note: Four home games in one week is rare ,  Chase Center is THE place to be this week.

Both the Giants (Oracle Park) and the Oakland Ballers (Raimondi Park) have finished their 2026 seasons. Giants return to Oracle Park in July 2027. Watch for Oakland Ballers' 2027 schedule announcement.

concerts.d: New Orleans funk legends open their two-night Fillmore Halloween run with 18-year-old guitar prodigy Bella Rayne on support. Galactic's Halloween shows are the stuff of legend ,  expect nonstop groove from start to finish.

Night two of the Fillmore Halloween run features instrumental organ trio Parlor Greens as support ,  and Galactic on actual Halloween is arguably the best way to spend October 31st in San Francisco. Dress up.

The legendary country trio brings their powerhouse harmonies and bold artistry to The Masonic ,  rare Bay Area appearances from one of the most iconic acts in American music. A genuinely special night for country and roots fans.

The soulful lo-fi gospel-R&B singer plays the stunning Art Deco Castro Theatre ,  his vulnerable, intimate sound in that spectacular room is going to be something. Perfect Halloween alternative if you'd rather feel things than dance.

concerts.t: folkYEAH! Presents: A Night of the Living Dead - Paul Simon Halloween Ball
concerts.d: Lebo, Holly Bowling, Wally Ingram, Elliott Peck, and more become Bone Diggers for a one-night-only Halloween tribute to Paul Simon's catalog at The Chapel. Wildly creative and musically impeccable ,  this one is for the music nerds.

LA psych-rock fuzz merchants Frankie and the Witch Fingers bring their woozy, hypnotic live show to GAMH with Carrion Kids and Starzdust in tow. The perfect post-Halloween Sunday comedown ,  or continuation, depending on your weekend.

The beloved Mexican singer-songwriter brings his poetic, emotionally-charged solo artistry to The Fillmore ,  a wonderful pick for fans of Latin alternative and indie rock who want something beautiful on a Sunday night.

Freak-folk icon with an otherworldly baritone and playful mysticism plays The Fillmore ,  the venue practically was made for this kind of singular, intimate artistry. One of those shows you'll be talking about for years.

Ella Williams' luminous folk-indie project plays The Chapel with beloved local openers Sour Widows ,  a hushed, evocative Thursday night that will hit you right in the chest. Tickets around $27, and the perfect way to close out the week.

concerts.t: Team Dresch + Longstocking + The Third Sex
concerts.d: Queercore punk legends reunite at Bottom of the Hill for a raw, electrifying all-ages night of punk history and pure intensity. If you know, you know ,  and if you don't, this is a great time to get educated.

concertsOngoing.d: Jazz guitar legend at Miner Auditorium Friday Oct 30 ,  intimate, world-class, unmissable for jazz fans.

concertsOngoing.t: My Brightest Diamond at Ann Getty Center
concertsOngoing.d: Shara Nova's avant-pop orchestral spectacle Friday Oct 30 ,  a breathtaking and intimate performance.

concertsOngoing.t: High Step Society at The Independent
concertsOngoing.d: Electro-swing funk electronic dance party Friday Oct 30 at 9pm ,  the whole crowd will be moving.

concertsOngoing.t: Dave Hause at Café du Nord
concertsOngoing.d: Philly punk-folk storyteller in Café du Nord's intimate basement Thursday Nov 5 ,  cult favorite show.

singles.t: FALL for Someone SF - Speed Dating Ages 25-45
singles.d: Seasonally themed speed dating night at ERIA Marina aimed at the 25-45 crowd ,  one of the more charming formats in the city's dating calendar right now. The Marina neighborhood venue keeps things upscale without being stuffy, and the Halloween-week timing makes everyone a little more fun.

singles.t: San Francisco Singles Speed Dating Game Night
singles.d: Speed dating meets interactive games at Iron Horse Cocktails ,  a genuinely fun twist on the format that takes the pressure way down. Breaking the ice is literally built into the structure, which means you can just show up and enjoy yourself instead of sweating your opener.

singles.t: Slow Runners Club - Sunday Morning Run
singles.d: Meet at the Panhandle (Baker & Oak) for a social run through Golden Gate Park at a genuinely beginner-friendly 10-15 min/mile pace. One of the best low-pressure ways to meet people in this city ,  you're exercising together, which gives you something to talk about that isn't 'so what do you do'.

singles.t: Speed Dating for 40s & 50s at Hotel Zeppelin
singles.d: The Society of Single Professionals hosts an upscale speed dating night at Hotel Zeppelin on Post Street ,  specifically designed for singles in their 40s and 50s, five minutes per person, and prior dates have sold out. Book early, dress well, and actually show up.

singles.t: Midnight Runners SF - Wednesday City Run
singles.d: A city run with music, workout stops, and a genuine party vibe ,  find the route on the Heylo app and show up ready to sweat and socialize in equal measure. Midnight Runners SF is one of the city's most energetic social clubs and a legitimately great way to meet people who aren't glued to their phones.

singles.t: Mother Armenia: Sha Ray & DJ Haram - Critical Thot Live
singles.d: Just outside the week but worth planning ahead ,  DJ Haram's abrasive percussion meets Sha Ray's defiant vocals in a genuinely unique live performance at Underground SF, with Discnogirl and DJ Ari B also on the bill. The kind of night where you'll have a great story by midnight.

singlesOngoing.d: Coed volleyball Mondays at John O'Connell Gym and basketball Thursdays at the JCC ,  register for the November season.
Tuesday and Thursday evening runs plus Saturday mornings through November 1 ,  social, beginner-friendly, and a genuinely great way to meet people.
